before.reason: Both wrapper and wrapper-free probes failed; the latter tried to open the caller-configured build directory outside the probe's writable root.

controls: A missing wrapper is classified Disabled only after a real wrapper-free crate build succeeds.
The probe leaves caller target and build directories absent.
Actual confined Cargo launches produce the fixture executable and reuse the wrapper measurement across unrelated tool-policy changes.

limits: The probe qualification ran alongside the prepared Native test-target split. The two runtime source files match this change byte for byte; adjacent policy, sandbox and Core sources match its base.
This is output-isolation and wrapper-classification evidence, not a hosted CI latency measurement.
